verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets running operations "from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline" and ships an official terminal-native CLI. That CLI authenticates non-interactively via a MERCURY_API_KEY environment variable, backed by a REST API, scoped read-only/read-write/custom tokens, an official Go SDK, and a sandbox with separate base URLs for safe automated testing. Missing for 10: a dedicated CI/headless usage guide (e.g., non-interactive flags or CI recipes) and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI running in CI.
